issues.description: Method name mismatch: the specification/UML and task description require a public method named printFarmSong() in class Farm, but both the template and the solution implement a method named singFarmSong() instead. Problem statement: UML lists + printFarmSong():void (problem_statement.md line 20) and Part 3 instructs to implement printFarmSong() (problem_statement.md line 112). Template: Farm.java declares public void singFarmSong() (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java lines 9-11). Solution: Farm.java implements public void singFarmSong() (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java lines 59-64). This naming inconsistency can confuse students about which method to implement and which method tests or provided Main expect, and may cause failing tests or mismatches between exercise text and code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent: either (A) update the problem statement and UML to refer to singFarmSong() everywhere (so tasks instruct students to implement singFarmSong()), or (B) rename the method in both the template and the solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() (keeping the same behavior and visibility). Ensure Main and any tests reference the same method name as the specification.

issues.description: Method naming mismatch for the Farm song method: the problem statement instructs students to implement a method named printFarmSong() (problem artifact calls it `printFarmSong()`), while both the starter template and the reference solution declare and use a method named singFarmSong() (template/solution define `singFarmSong()`). This inconsistency means students reading the problem will look for or try to implement `printFarmSong()` but the provided template and example code use `singFarmSong()`, creating confusion about which method to implement and which name tests or example calls expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) update the problem statement to refer to singFarmSong() everywhere (change the text that currently says `printFarmSong()` to `singFarmSong()`), or (B) rename the public method in the template and solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong(), and update any calls (e.g., Main and any tests) and documentation accordingly. Ensure the chosen name is used uniformly in problem text, template code, solution code, example Main calls, and tests.
